title: Easy to use and perfect for a working focus
body: There are time where you just need to bang out a lot of work. Personally I find it is very easy to be distracted by emails, workmates and busy work. Focus keeper does just as the name suggests. Set intervals and break lengths and power through that backlog of tasks. Easy to learn and use you won’t find a better implementation of the pomodoro method.

author: ?Scoozi

title: Simple & effective
body: This app has been key in helping me stay focussed and in task. The fact that you cN set the number of cycles you want & it automatically counts for you is part of what makes it so effective. I’m also a huge fan of not complicating stuff and just having an app do what it’s meant to do. Only reason I didn’t give it 5 stars is because it doesn’t have a feature that automatically turns on do not disturb during a focus session. That would be so helpful.

Good app, the timer sound is better than other apps imo.
